description: The cloud LLM returns a masked response where token case has been altered (e.g., «ent_org_001» instead of «ENT_ORG_001»). The decoder must normalize and rehydrate correctly.
input_masked_text: This agreement is between «ent_org_001» and «ENT_ORG_002», effective today.
expected_post_rehydrate_text: This agreement is between ACME Corp and Beta Holdings LLC, effective today.
detection: Decoder normalizes case-variant tokens to the KEY STORE canonical form before substitution.
recovery: Decoder prompt instructs: 'If a token appears with slight variants, normalize to the KEY STORE form.'
